claims.head: Who blinks first?
claims.body: The Wild are near the top of the league for shot volume, but the Mammoth are one of the best at keeping shots away. Our lean: the Mammoth hold the line.
claims.call: The Mammoth keep the Wild’s shot volume score under 100, the league average.
claims.see: Fewer than 46 shot attempts for the Wild at 5-on-5, which usually means 28 or fewer shots on goal on the scoreboard.

claims.head: The Mammoth will send Weegar and Sergachev at Kaprizov
claims.call: The Mammoth’s P1 (Weegar and Sergachev) spends at least 46% of its 5-on-5 time against the Wild’s first line.
claims.body: At home, the Mammoth keep sending Weegar and Sergachev out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. André Tourigny has been picking a defense pair for the other team’s top line. Tonight the Wild’s first line is Kaprizov, Ek and Boldy.
claims.nums: At home: 46% of this group’s 5-on-5 time against first lines, about 31% with no line matching
claims.gist: At home, André Tourigny likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Wild’s first line.

With no line matching, this group would face first lines about 31% of the time, about as often as those lines are on the ice.

claims.head: The Mammoth roll four lines, the Wild lean on their top six
claims.body: On depth, Utah is the league’s best, but Minnesota is near the bottom. If this one comes down to the bottom six, that suits the Mammoth.

notes.text: Marcus Foligno is on injured reserve and has missed the last 9 games. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
Brock Faber is on injured reserve (skull surgery) and has not played this season. He is a top-pair defenseman. Jared Spurgeon has taken his spot beside Quinn Hughes.
Tyler Pitlick was added to the roster on Oct 13 and has played beside Ryan Hartman and Nico Sturm.
John Marino is out week to week (upper body injury) and has missed the last 3 games. He is a top-pair defenseman. Andrew Peeke has taken his spot beside Nate Schmidt.

UTA.head: Too close to call
UTA.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. Utah will be without Marino, but they have home-ice advantage. For the Mammoth, the difference could be a power play that gets going.

MIN.head: A genuine toss-up
MIN.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. Utah will be without Marino, but they have home-ice advantage. For the Wild, the difference could be a power play that gets going.

story.head: Who blinks first?
paras: The Mammoth are 8-4-0. The Wild have won two in a row.

items.text: The Wild have been without Marcus Foligno since Oct 8, and have had to make do without Filip Gustavsson and Brock Faber all season. Jesper Wallstedt is expected to start.
Vincent Trocheck has a point in five straight games against Minnesota, with a goal in each of the last four.
The Mammoth have been without John Marino since Oct 17.
Mikhail Sergachev has a point in four straight games.
